local_review.review_comment: Reviewed the single-coordinate diff against the library-new-request review signals. The scaffold placeholder is replaced by MySQLDatabaseTest and MariaDBDatabaseTest in the separate org_flywaydb.flyway_mysql package, which run Flyway migrate, info, validate and clean against MySQL 26.7.1 and MariaDB 13.0 containers from the allowed images listed in required-docker-images.txt, using filesystem migrations with DELIMITER-delimited procedures and functions, triggers, events, views, sequences and system-versioned tables. There is no native skip, error-swallowing catch, version-pinned assertion, or legacy metadata file. The one native build flag, --enable-url-protocols=https, meets the necessity rule: every Flyway instance initializes flyway-core's FlywayDbWebsiteLinks, whose static initializer builds https URLs, so all six native tests failed with a MalformedURLException without it; the need comes from the flyway-core dependency, the flag names only that protocol, and the flyway-core and flyway-sqlserver test projects carry the same flag. The library JAR has no dynamic-access call sites, so stats.json reports 0/0, and library line coverage is 70.17%. The tracing agent recorded 2 library metadata entries and 530 test-only entries, and no scenario was dropped. All three Forge native lanes, metadata and style checks, and statistics validation pass.
